verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own docs claim automatic categorization of imported transactions (up to 98% when Brex is connected) and an in-context "ask AI" button for categorization help, so the suggestion half of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows the categorizer learning from user corrections; custom rules exist but are user-authored, which is an adjacent control and not adaptive learning. Missing for 10: documented learning from user corrections, detail on how suggestions are presented and reviewed, independent or hands-on corroboration of categorization accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: 98% transactions categorized When you connect Brex with Puzzle
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
